issues.body: CARGO_INSTALL_ALLOWLIST is keyed only by filename, and test_no_source_compile_outside_allowlist subtracts that filename regardless of how many matches it contains or which job contains them. test_allowlist_is_not_stale merely checks that release.yml has at least one match. Thus a new `cargo install wasm-pack` in any other release.yml job—or a duplicate in gui-bundle—passes, despite the comments and docs-quality label claiming exactly one allowlisted site. This leaves a material hole in the repo-wide regression gate the PR introduces.
issues.fix_hint: Represent the exemption at site granularity (for example workflow + job id, or an exact expected step identity) and assert exactly one matching source-install step in release.yml, located in gui-bundle. Add a mutation test with a second source-install step in another release job and verify that it fails.
issues.title: The release exemption allowlists an entire workflow instead of one install site

verdict.summary: The workflow conversions themselves are consistent and the new test suite passes, but the repo-wide guard does not enforce the exemption it claims: it allowlists all of release.yml rather than the single gui-bundle install site. Consequently, another source-compiled wasm-pack step can be added anywhere in release.yml without failing the gate. The allowlist needs site-level matching and cardinality enforcement before this is a complete regression guard.
